limits: Everything here follows from what the host wrote. Discrimination is computed from the predicted values given, so a wrong prediction produces a wrong separation.
Two predictions differ only when their values differ. Wording is never compared, and two readouts named differently are treated as different readouts.
Evidence roles and readings are the host's interpretation. Counting studies says how many papers were cited, not that any of them supports the claim.
Mechanism links are case candidates. A graph path means the curated graph holds a route between two exactly-matched entities; it says nothing about this case's conditions.
Nothing here ranks experiments. Which to run first is the host's argument and the researcher's decision.

Two hypotheses predicting different values on a readout is not a measure of how well the experiment would discriminate them, and says nothing about separating causes acting together: effect size, noise and interference are not modelled.
A state (present/absent) and a change (increase/decrease/no_change) are different claims and are never compared; neither are two changes stated against different references.
Prediction traces follow the references the host gave. A connected path is not a verified causal chain.

confirmed: Resazurin signal decreased after compound exposure
host_assumptions: Whether the compound is coloured, fluorescent or redox-active is unknown

goal_trace.statement: Decide whether the lower signal reflects cytotoxicity before calling the compound cytotoxic
If activity per cell is lower, locate it: mitochondrial content or function

host_readings: Tetrazolium and resazurin reduction reflect reductive activity rather than cell number: count cells separately.
Resazurin is reduced via mitochondrial and other reductases using NAD(P)H-linked capacity.
A cell-free resazurin + material incubation only tests chemical reduction; it does not rule out quenching or adsorption of resorufin.
Product controls needed: resorufin alone and resorufin + material, no cells.
Coloured, fluorescent or redox-active substances distort readouts; confirm with orthogonal endpoints.
Metabolic readings moved (serum-free) while live/dead and attachment did not: metabolic signal can move without viability.
Normalising respiration to mitochondrial content (citrate synthase) separates content from intrinsic function.
Mass fell while respiration was preserved, in human skeletal muscle after bed rest; a different system.
Maximal OCR from the standard stress test can be unreliable (17% of assays had maximal < basal).
About half of basal OCR is not coupled to ATP synthesis; part is non-mitochondrial (same study as lit-be2c3c428bde).
